overall.summary: NTAP's Q1 FY2026 10-Q filing shows a systematic pattern of disclosure reduction across multiple material risk categories. The most concerning finding is the near-complete removal of geopolitical, tariff, and trade policy risk discussions from both MD&A and Risk Factors sections — topics that were extensively disclosed in the prior quarter and have become more material, not less, in the intervening period.
